featured_reviews.name: Rafiya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

The pen is still visible in the product images, and I have screenshots of the original description showing it was included when I purchased. Very disappointing experience and poor customer service. featured_reviews.review_text: Big, beautiful place, good variety of products. The shop decoration looks luxury until you don't dare to get in but the price is affordable. However, not many low price small items which you can buy in bulk e.g Keychain, coin purse lower than 150 rupees.

featured_reviews.name: Nishath Parveen
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had been to the flagship store, which was founded in 1906 by Lokmanya Tilak.
The Bombay Store has been celebrating Indian heritage for over a century!!
You get an array of handcrafted items , ideal for gifting and using at home.
The artistically presented trays, cousters, mugs are a must have!!

featured_reviews.name: Monica Araya
featured_reviews.review_text: I loved this place, you can take your time to find exactly what you are looking for, from notebooks and scarves to candles, ceramics and larger decorative items. We had been looking for a place like this one for a out 1 hour and we were happy to discover it! I like that no one in the shop puts pressure to buy. They are there, quietly, in case you have questions. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Narvekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Great team of floor staff supporting you while you hunt for India souvenirs. From traditional Indian arts to a blended modernist homeware, it's got a good range catering to every taste. Clear and decent pricing with an assurance of quality. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Rajbhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just best experience ever,
As an Artist & Historian we fall into this beautiful aesthetically arranged and well Managed  place, it just seems like I haven't even seen much things, loved to explore more for the next time..!!

featured_reviews.name: shubhada choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text: For office purpose I bought 3-4 items from the Bombay Stores.  Everyone liked it .  Thank you 😊

featured_reviews.name: Rene Aarsman
featured_reviews.review_text: Wonderful shop, full of old world charm and full of beautiful things. Best place to do some souvenir hunting.

featured_reviews.name: Dan Peyton
featured_reviews.review_text: The flagship store was the perfect place to go for souvenirs and small gifts. Wasn’t planning to buy anything but ended up with a bag load of goodies. Could have been far more if I was prepared which I will be next time. Enjoyed the fresh tea samples brewed especially for us and prices were very reasonable
